title: Secret Lair Countdown: card flavor text

entities.name: Gray Merchant of Asphodel
entities.description: A figure who seeks to prove that you can take it with you.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A figure whose life of desperation is described as quite loud.

entities.name: Yarok, the Desecrated
entities.description: A creature whose exploits stalking jungles and quags are recorded by Bala Ged scribes.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A region whose scribes record Yarok's exploits.

entities.name: Zo-Zu the Punisher
entities.description: An akki regarded for his cleverness who makes puns and shoots fire.

entities.name: Akki
entities.description: A people among whom Zo-Zu's cleverness is well regarded.

entities.name: Shivan Dragon
entities.description: A dragon that takes particular glee in tormenting its victims.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin mockingly called a general.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A character who scoffs at Squee being called general.

entities.name: Genesis
entities.description: The first being through the Riftstone, who ended the world's lifelessness.

entities.name: Riftstone
entities.description: A stone through which Genesis first came.

entities.name: Scroll of Beginnings
entities.description: An in-world writing recounting Genesis.

entities.name: Dosan
entities.description: A man to whom nature revealed itself as he sat in repose.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A faction with an army of soldiers and respected mage-priests.

entities.name: Twila
entities.description: A Gilt-Leaf archdruid who urges study of great spirits and lineage.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf
entities.description: The group of which Twila is archdruid.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A group whose war beasts send enemies fleeing.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A heretic cathar who says salvation must be earned, not granted by the Lunarch Council.

entities.name: Lunarch Council
entities.description: A council Thalia says will not grant salvation.

entities.name: Turnipsons
entities.description: A family whose turn it is in the good soil this week.

events.summary: Dosan sits in repose for hours and nature reveals itself to him.
events.quote: And as he sat, nature revealed itself to him.

events.summary: Genesis is the first through the Riftstone, bringing life to the world.
events.quote: "First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more."

events.summary: Tahngarth mocks the notion of Squee as a general.
